## Brand & Style

This design system is tailored for an institutional Learning Management System (LMS) serving teachers and students at SMPN 1 Umbulsari. The personality is utilitarian, highly focused, academic, and calm. It reduces administrative fatigue and cognitive overload during prolonged classroom and home usage.

The design movement is **Editorial Minimalism** crossed with modern high-density utility:
- **Structural Integrity:** Space is treated as a premium asset. Density is preserved using horizontal 1-row stat strips, concise tabular views, and an explicit refusal of decorative containers or frivolous illustrations.
- **Rule of One Primary Action:** Each screen surface enforces exactly one prominent filled call-to-action to eliminate choice hesitation for students during assessments and instructors configuring curricula.
- **Hairlines Over Shadows:** Elevation is established strictly through 1px border rules (`--line`) and subtle contrast shifts rather than heavy drop shadows.
- **Defensive Performance:** Lightweight, robust visual architecture optimized for resource-constrained client devices, adhering strictly to standard 60fps interaction and mobile viewport stability.

## Colors

The palette balances a focused institutional blue with crisp paper-white surfaces and slate-tinted canvas neutrals. The system avoids saturated fills across wide areas, deploying chroma purely for interaction states and pedagogical taxonomy.

### Semantic Question Taxonomy Tokens
- **PG (Multiple Choice):** `badge-pg` (`#1d4ed8`) on `badge-pg-bg` (`#eff6ff`). Signifies objective, standard automated scoring.
- **BS (True/False):** `badge-bs` (`#16a34a`) on `badge-bs-bg` (`#f0fdf4`). Conveys verified binary answers and successful states.
- **MATCH (Matching):** `badge-match` (`#d97706`) on `badge-match-bg` (`#fffbeb`). Alerts instructors to relational associative checks and pending review dates.
- **ESSAY (Subjective):** `badge-essay` (`#dc2626`) on `badge-essay-bg` (`#fef2f2`). High-urgency indicator alerting the educator that manual grading is strictly required.

### Structural Rules
- Surfaces are layered: Canvas uses `paper` (`#f8fafc`), interactive modules rest on `surface` (`#ffffff`), and structural boundaries strictly use `line` (`#e2e8f0`).
- Text uses high-contrast `ink` (`#0f172a`) for readability in well-lit classrooms, while metadata and timestamps lean on `ink-muted` (`#64748b`).
- Zebra striping on data grids is faint, utilizing `line-soft` (`#f1f5f9`).

## Typography

The typography system relies exclusively on a single geometric humanist sans-serif (`Inter`) to maintain performance, reduce HTTP requests, and ensure consistent rendering across low-spec student mobile devices and school desktop labs.

### Rules of Engagement
- **Tabular Figures Everywhere:** Any numeric context (grades, timers, student roll numbers, timestamps, point tallies) must activate `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to preserve column alignment and stop visual jittering on updating timers.
- **No All-Caps Tracking:** Never transform UI labels or metadata to uppercase with expanded letter-spacing. Natural sentence case or standard title capitalization preserves fast academic skimming.
- **No Mid-Heading Italics or Eyebrow Subtitles:** Keep heading areas clean without superfluous categorization pills directly stacked on top of titles.
- **Mobile Input Defense:** All `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` elements on screens ≤768px must compute to an explicit `16px` font size to stop automatic zooming behaviors on WebKit browsers.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout philosophy follows a strict asymmetric utility model optimized for typical 1366×768 resolution school monitors and 360–420px mobile viewports.

### Desktop Layout (≥992px)
- **Left Icon Rail:** Fixed width of `64px`, full viewport height, pinned to the left edge containing the institutional seal and core section SVGs.
- **Main Canvas Constraint:** Fixed maximum content width of `1040px`, strictly aligned to the left of the view (never centered in a vast expanse of unused space). Main canvas padding is set to `34px 44px 30px`.
- **Two-Column Split:** Main body uses an asymmetric split grid ratio of `1.45fr / 1fr` with a fixed gap of `14px` (`space-md`). Left side handles task lists, material feeds, and form inputs; right side handles real-time timer summaries, quick grading queues, and status bars.
- **Vertical Constraint:** Header filters and summary strips must not exceed `100px` in total height.

### Mobile Reflow (≤768px)
- **Single Stack:** Sidebar vanishes; layout converts to a 100% wide single-column flow with `margin: 1.25rem` (`20px`) horizontal inline padding.
- **Bottom Navigation Bar:** Fixed at the bottom containing 4 primary target destinations, height `56px`, utilizing touch-friendly `44px` square hit boxes.
- **Viewport Protection:** Root document uses `overflow-x: clip` to completely prevent unintentional horizontal nudging during test-taking.

### Spatial Safety Gap
- Maintain an explicit spatial buffer of `≥32px` (`space-2xl`) between a primary completion action (e.g., "Kirim Tugas", "Simpan Soal") and any destructive triggers (e.g., "Hapus Soal", "Batalkan Ujian").

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy is constructed entirely without traditional drop shadows. The design system uses an **Architectural Hairline** model:

- **Planes & Surfaces:** Elevation steps are represented via background tonality shifts—moving from the default canvas background (`paper`, `#f8fafc`) up to cards and inputs (`surface`, `#ffffff`).
- **Hairline Definition:** Structural containment is handled with crisp `1px solid var(--line)` (`#e2e8f0`). Internal component list item dividers use the lighter `1px solid var(--line-soft)` (`#f1f5f9`).
- **Accent Edges:** High-priority cards (such as an ongoing timed exam or active submission requirement) use a prominent left border: `4px solid var(--primary-color-hex)`.
- **Modals and Sheets:** Drop shadows are isolated exclusively to floating dialogs, dropdown popovers, and mobile bottom action sheets, where a sharp, low-opacity ambient blur (`0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08)`) is permitted to separate the active focus context from the backdrop.
- **Feedback Toasts:** Compact floating pills feature a `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` with semi-opaque surfaces, disappearing automatically on a 3-second timer.

## Shapes

The shape system expresses clean, technical precision. Corners are controlled and compact rather than overtly bulbous, retaining maximum display area for complex assessment layouts.

- **Inputs, Buttons, and Form Controls:** Formatted with `9px` to `10px` radius for a balanced, modern feel that cleanly encases text at `13.5px` and `16px`.
- **Cards and Panels:** Fixed at `12px` to `14px` radius with `1px` exterior borders.
- **Badges and Pills:** Rounded at `6px` for tabular question tags (`PG`, `BS`), while status flags and floating indicators (such as the active countdown timer) use full pill shapes (`999px`).
- **Progress Track Indicators:** Small elements like slim horizontal progress strips use `2px` border radius to maintain sharp terminal boundaries.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Only 1 Per Screen):** Solid `#1d4ed8` fill with crisp white `#ffffff` typography. Desktop padding: `9px 16px`, mobile padding: `12px 16px`. Hover state darkens slightly to `#1e40af`.
- **Ghost / Secondary:** Surface background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a`. Hover transitions to background `#f8fafc`.
- **Destructive:** Border `1px solid #fecaca`, text `#dc2626`, background transparent. Hover shifts to `#fef2f2`. Must be spaced `≥32px` away from primary actions.

### Stat Strip (1-Row Density)
- Replaces bulky widget cards with a single horizontal flex strip enclosed in a `1px` hairline box.
- Columns are separated by internal vertical `1px` borders.
- Top label: `12.5px` (`#64748b`), value: `29px` semi-bold tabular numbers (`#0f172a`), bottom caption: `12px` (`#64748b`).

### Question Type Chips & Badges
- Compact capsules (`padding: 3px 8px`, radius `6px`, font size `11px`, weight `600`).
- **PG:** `#1d4ed8` text, `#eff6ff` background.
- **BS:** `#16a34a` text, `#f0fdf4` background.
- **MATCH:** `#d97706` text, `#fffbeb` background.
- **ESSAY:** `#dc2626` text, `#fef2f2` background.

### Input Fields & Controls
- Height strictly `≥40px`. Padding: `10px 12px`. Border: `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Radius: `9px`. Background: `#ffffff`.
- Focus ring: `outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px;`.
- Touch target minimum: `44px × 44px` on mobile viewports.

### Cards & Container Panels
- Background: `#ffffff`. Border: `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Radius: `12px` (outer cards `14px`). Padding: `16px`.
- Card list rows: Padded vertically `12px 0`, separated with hairline border-bottom `1px solid #f1f5f9`.

## Brand & Style

This design system is tailored for an institutional Learning Management System (LMS) serving teachers and students at SMPN 1 Umbulsari. The personality is utilitarian, highly focused, academic, and calm. It reduces administrative fatigue and cognitive overload during prolonged classroom and home usage.

The design movement is **Editorial Minimalism** crossed with modern high-density utility:
- **Structural Integrity:** Space is treated as a premium asset. Density is preserved using horizontal 1-row stat strips, concise tabular views, and an explicit refusal of decorative containers or frivolous illustrations.
- **Rule of One Primary Action:** Each screen surface enforces exactly one prominent filled call-to-action to eliminate choice hesitation for students during assessments and instructors configuring curricula.
- **Hairlines Over Shadows:** Elevation is established strictly through 1px border rules (`--line`) and subtle contrast shifts rather than heavy drop shadows.
- **Defensive Performance:** Lightweight, robust visual architecture optimized for resource-constrained client devices, adhering strictly to standard 60fps interaction and mobile viewport stability.

## Colors

The palette balances a focused institutional blue with crisp paper-white surfaces and slate-tinted canvas neutrals. The system avoids saturated fills across wide areas, deploying chroma purely for interaction states and pedagogical taxonomy.

### Semantic Question Taxonomy Tokens
- **PG (Multiple Choice):** `badge-pg` (`#1d4ed8`) on `badge-pg-bg` (`#eff6ff`). Signifies objective, standard automated scoring.
- **BS (True/False):** `badge-bs` (`#16a34a`) on `badge-bs-bg` (`#f0fdf4`). Conveys verified binary answers and successful states.
- **MATCH (Matching):** `badge-match` (`#d97706`) on `badge-match-bg` (`#fffbeb`). Alerts instructors to relational associative checks and pending review dates.
- **ESSAY (Subjective):** `badge-essay` (`#dc2626`) on `badge-essay-bg` (`#fef2f2`). High-urgency indicator alerting the educator that manual grading is strictly required.

### Structural Rules
- Surfaces are layered: Canvas uses `paper` (`#f8fafc`), interactive modules rest on `surface` (`#ffffff`), and structural boundaries strictly use `line` (`#e2e8f0`).
- Text uses high-contrast `ink` (`#0f172a`) for readability in well-lit classrooms, while metadata and timestamps lean on `ink-muted` (`#64748b`).
- Zebra striping on data grids is faint, utilizing `line-soft` (`#f1f5f9`).

## Typography

The typography system relies exclusively on a single geometric humanist sans-serif (`Inter`) to maintain performance, reduce HTTP requests, and ensure consistent rendering across low-spec student mobile devices and school desktop labs.

### Rules of Engagement
- **Tabular Figures Everywhere:** Any numeric context (grades, timers, student roll numbers, timestamps, point tallies) must activate `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to preserve column alignment and stop visual jittering on updating timers.
- **No All-Caps Tracking:** Never transform UI labels or metadata to uppercase with expanded letter-spacing. Natural sentence case or standard title capitalization preserves fast academic skimming.
- **No Mid-Heading Italics or Eyebrow Subtitles:** Keep heading areas clean without superfluous categorization pills directly stacked on top of titles.
- **Mobile Input Defense:** All `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` elements on screens ≤768px must compute to an explicit `16px` font size to stop automatic zooming behaviors on WebKit browsers.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout philosophy follows a strict asymmetric utility model optimized for typical 1366×768 resolution school monitors and 360–420px mobile viewports.

### Desktop Layout (≥992px)
- **Left Icon Rail:** Fixed width of `64px`, full viewport height, pinned to the left edge containing the institutional seal and core section SVGs.
- **Main Canvas Constraint:** Fixed maximum content width of `1040px`, strictly aligned to the left of the view (never centered in a vast expanse of unused space). Main canvas padding is set to `34px 44px 30px`.
- **Two-Column Split:** Main body uses an asymmetric split grid ratio of `1.45fr / 1fr` with a fixed gap of `14px` (`space-md`). Left side handles task lists, material feeds, and form inputs; right side handles real-time timer summaries, quick grading queues, and status bars.
- **Vertical Constraint:** Header filters and summary strips must not exceed `100px` in total height.

### Mobile Reflow (≤768px)
- **Single Stack:** Sidebar vanishes; layout converts to a 100% wide single-column flow with `margin: 1.25rem` (`20px`) horizontal inline padding.
- **Bottom Navigation Bar:** Fixed at the bottom containing 4 primary target destinations, height `56px`, utilizing touch-friendly `44px` square hit boxes.
- **Viewport Protection:** Root document uses `overflow-x: clip` to completely prevent unintentional horizontal nudging during test-taking.

### Spatial Safety Gap
- Maintain an explicit spatial buffer of `≥32px` (`space-2xl`) between a primary completion action (e.g., "Kirim Tugas", "Simpan Soal") and any destructive triggers (e.g., "Hapus Soal", "Batalkan Ujian").

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy is constructed entirely without traditional drop shadows. The design system uses an **Architectural Hairline** model:

- **Planes & Surfaces:** Elevation steps are represented via background tonality shifts—moving from the default canvas background (`paper`, `#f8fafc`) up to cards and inputs (`surface`, `#ffffff`).
- **Hairline Definition:** Structural containment is handled with crisp `1px solid var(--line)` (`#e2e8f0`). Internal component list item dividers use the lighter `1px solid var(--line-soft)` (`#f1f5f9`).
- **Accent Edges:** High-priority cards (such as an ongoing timed exam or active submission requirement) use a prominent left border: `4px solid var(--primary-color-hex)`.
- **Modals and Sheets:** Drop shadows are isolated exclusively to floating dialogs, dropdown popovers, and mobile bottom action sheets, where a sharp, low-opacity ambient blur (`0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08)`) is permitted to separate the active focus context from the backdrop.
- **Feedback Toasts:** Compact floating pills feature a `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` with semi-opaque surfaces, disappearing automatically on a 3-second timer.

## Shapes

The shape system expresses clean, technical precision. Corners are controlled and compact rather than overtly bulbous, retaining maximum display area for complex assessment layouts.

- **Inputs, Buttons, and Form Controls:** Formatted with `9px` to `10px` radius for a balanced, modern feel that cleanly encases text at `13.5px` and `16px`.
- **Cards and Panels:** Fixed at `12px` to `14px` radius with `1px` exterior borders.
- **Badges and Pills:** Rounded at `6px` for tabular question tags (`PG`, `BS`), while status flags and floating indicators (such as the active countdown timer) use full pill shapes (`999px`).
- **Progress Track Indicators:** Small elements like slim horizontal progress strips use `2px` border radius to maintain sharp terminal boundaries.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Only 1 Per Screen):** Solid `#1d4ed8` fill with crisp white `#ffffff` typography. Desktop padding: `9px 16px`, mobile padding: `12px 16px`. Hover state darkens slightly to `#1e40af`.
- **Ghost / Secondary:** Surface background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a`. Hover transitions to background `#f8fafc`.
- **Destructive:** Border `1px solid #fecaca`, text `#dc2626`, background transparent. Hover shifts to `#fef2f2`. Must be spaced `≥32px` away from primary actions.

### Stat Strip (1-Row Density)
- Replaces bulky widget cards with a single horizontal flex strip enclosed in a `1px` hairline box.
- Columns are separated by internal vertical `1px` borders.
- Top label: `12.5px` (`#64748b`), value: `29px` semi-bold tabular numbers (`#0f172a`), bottom caption: `12px` (`#64748b`).

### Question Type Chips & Badges
- Compact capsules (`padding: 3px 8px`, radius `6px`, font size `11px`, weight `600`).
- **PG:** `#1d4ed8` text, `#eff6ff` background.
- **BS:** `#16a34a` text, `#f0fdf4` background.
- **MATCH:** `#d97706` text, `#fffbeb` background.
- **ESSAY:** `#dc2626` text, `#fef2f2` background.

### Input Fields & Controls
- Height strictly `≥40px`. Padding: `10px 12px`. Border: `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Radius: `9px`. Background: `#ffffff`.
- Focus ring: `outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px;`.
- Touch target minimum: `44px × 44px` on mobile viewports.

### Cards & Container Panels
- Background: `#ffffff`. Border: `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Radius: `12px` (outer cards `14px`). Padding: `16px`.
- Card list rows: Padded vertically `12px 0`, separated with hairline border-bottom `1px solid #f1f5f9`.

### Assessment Timer Pill
- Pill container (`radius: 999px`) featuring `1px solid #1d4ed8`, containing an inline stopwatch SVG icon and active tabular monospace numbers `mm:ss`. Background: `#eff6ff`.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system embodies an academic, utilitarian, and deeply focused aesthetic tailored for structured educational workflows and deep work. Rooted in technical minimalism and developer-grade clarity, it eschews excessive decoration in favor of high-legibility typographic hierarchies, strict geometric discipline, and deliberate high-contrast contrast ratios against a nocturnal palette.

The visual language draws inspiration from modern code repositories, technical documentation hubs, and research interfaces. It establishes an atmosphere of calm authority, cognitive efficiency, and systematic precision, ensuring long-session readability and reduced visual fatigue for students, researchers, and instructors alike.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model uses a fluid, dense grid structure optimized for high utility and screen real estate efficiency. The standard canvas uses a 12-column adaptive fluid grid on desktop and tablet, collapsing to 4 columns on mobile viewports.

Vertical and horizontal spacing maintains an economical cadence:
- **Canvas Margins**: 1.5rem (24px) on desktop, adjusting to 1rem (16px) on mobile viewports.
- **Gutters**: 1rem (16px) across desktop and tablet grids, contracting to 0.75rem (12px) on mobile.
- **Padding Cadence**: Internal component padding prioritizes tightness and density (`space-xs` to `space-md` for inputs, cards, and list rows), reserving `space-xl` strictly for macro section division.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth in this design system is achieved entirely through tonal layering and low-contrast outlines rather than drop shadows. Surface separation relies on contrasting background tones:
- **Canvas Level**: `paper` (`#0d1117`) and `surface-dim` (`#090d16`).
- **Interactive & Static Containers**: `surface` / `surface-container` (`#151b23`).
- **Raised & Hover Elements**: `surface-bright` (`#1c2430`) and `surface-container-high` (`#1e2633`).
- **Sunken Elements**: `surface-container-low` (`#0f141c`).

Borders provide structural perimeter clarity using `line` (`#252d38`) for cards, interactive controls, and active focus boundaries, and `line-soft` (`#1e252f`) for passive dividers and table rows. Heavy shadows are explicitly disallowed; dropdown menus or floating modals may utilize an ultra-subtle, non-directional dark occlusion shadow tinted to `#000000` at 40% opacity with a tight 8px blur to separate them from underlying dense panels.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Background `accent` (`#38bdf8`), text `#0d1117` (paper) in bold weight, 9px border radius, 0.5rem vertical by 0.75rem horizontal padding. Hover shifts to a slightly brightened sky tint.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: Background `surface-container` (`#151b23`), border 1px solid `line` (`#252d38`), text `ink` (`#f2f5f7`). Hover transitions background to `surface-bright` (`#1c2430`).
- **Subtle / Tertiary**: Transparent background, text `ink-2` (`#a3adba`), hovering to `ink` (`#f2f5f7`) with a background of `surface-bright` (`#1c2430`).

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Inputs & Selects**: Height 36px, border radius 9px, background `surface-container-low` (`#0f141c`), border 1px solid `line` (`#252d38`), text `ink` (`#f2f5f7`) with placeholder text in `ink-3` (`#6f7b8a`). Focus state displays a 1px border highlight in `accent` (`#38bdf8`) with an optional matching 2px focus glow.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px dimension, border 1px solid `line` (`#252d38`), background `surface-container-low` (`#0f141c`). Checked state fills with `accent` (`#38bdf8`) with an inner checkmark or pip in `paper` (`#0d1117`). Radios use a full pill radius; checkboxes use 4px radius.

### Badges & Chips
- **Badges**: 6px border radius, typography level `badge` (10.5px bold), padding 2px 6px. Semantic variants utilize tinted dark backgrounds (e.g., `accent-soft` `#0f2942` for information, dark green tint for `ok`, dark amber for `warn`, and dark red for `danger`) paired with matching high-contrast text.
- **Filter Chips**: 9999px pill radius, background `surface-container` (`#151b23`), border 1px solid `line` (`#252d38`), label in `label-sm` (11.5px). Selected state employs `accent-soft` background with an `accent` border and text.

### Cards & Panels
- **Structure**: 12px border radius, background `surface` (`#151b23`), border 1px solid `line` (`#252d38`).
- **Internal Padding**: 1rem to 1.25rem. Header dividers use 1px solid `line-soft` (`#1e252f`).

### Lists & Tables
- **Data Tables & Module Lists**: Border collapse with `1px solid line-soft` separators. Rows rest on `surface` background, with hover feedback transitioning smoothly to `surface-container-high` (`#1e2633`). Row padding is kept compact at 0.5rem vertical. Primary content uses `body-md` in `ink`, while secondary tabular data uses `meta` (11.5px) in `ink-2`.
